5258.html:
5258 jūṭa m. 'twisted hair' Mālatīm., °aka- m. lex. 2. *juṇṭa-. [Cf. cū́ḍa-¹ and *jhuṇṭa-²: for list of poss. connected words see jáṭā-]
    1. Pk. jūḍa- m. 'twisted hair'; S. jūṛo m. 'hair tied in a knot on crown', L. jūṛā m.; P. jūṛā m. 'Sikh's knot of hair, broom', jūṛī f. 'small knot of hair, small broom, bundle of jute or tobacco leaves'; N. juro 'woman's knot of hair, crest of bird, hood of snake, hump of bullock'; A. zur 'leaves of jute plant tied together for cooking', zuri 'wisp of grass tied round a tree'; Or. juṛā 'hair tied in a knot', Mth. jūrā, jūṛā ← H. jūṛā m.; G. jū̆ṛī f. 'bunch, bundle'; M. j̈uḷī f. 'bundle of leaves', j̈uḍā m., °ḍī f. 'knot of hair, bunch, bundle'.
    2. S. juṇḍā m. pl. 'short hairs'.
    *jūḍa- 'cold' see jaḍa-.
    Addenda: jūṭa-. 1. P. jūṛā m. 'top-knot, broom' (semant. cf. WPah.kṭg. ċvḷɔ < cū́ḍa-¹).
